name: TemplateView
summary: A page written as its own markup with the dynamic parts marked in it.

roles.name: TemplateView
roles.summary: A view that is written as the page it produces, so a designer can read it. The discipline it needs is stated in its own risk: logic in a template is logic nothing can test, which is why the pattern comes with the rule that a template calls a helper rather than deciding anything itself.
